title: Training Note: Open Review Courtesy on Residential Electricity Supply Rebill Credits
content:
Training note, Residential Electricity Supply rebill credits.

**Q. What is the open-review courtesy?**
A. A flat addition to a rebill credit that reflects billing disputes still under review on the same agreement. When the agreement carries two or more open billing disputes the multi-review courtesy of 10.00 USD is added, when it carries exactly one the single-review courtesy of 5.00 USD is added, and when it carries none nothing is added.

**Q. Which disputes count?**
A. Billing disputes recorded on the agreement whose status is open. Disputes that billing review has settled are not open and do not count.

| Open billing disputes on the agreement | Open-review courtesy |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10.00 USD |
| exactly 1 | 5.00 USD |
| none | nothing |
